own: I agree, and I like it like this. The people that were party to the trade are the ones that can initiate a dispute. But a team can also have it so their team members have access to the disputes. They can go in and see all the information. They can respond to the moderator because it's possible the lead is away or what have you. To keep it moving along, the team member can interact and provide whatever information because they have full access that's been granted to them as part of their granular settings if they've been given access to disputes. So, that's what I would say is it's for the people that have access to the dispute.
